mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown or recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and economic growth slow.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST and RSAFS both decline but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) rises above 55 while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tight labor market and supply constraints that will drive inflation and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1 percentage point cut in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) in a single month signals a panic easing by the Fed in response to a severe economic or financial shock, predicting a strong positive rebound in S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as markets stabilize.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS cut > 1pp in 1mo but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) accelerates by more than 2 percentage points year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong economy with tight labor markets that will drive wage inflation and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth > 2pp and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
